messages:
Ops-Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: cont-batch tail latency alert — p99 contiguous-batching path > 4.5s in us-west-2. Triggers: p99_token_latency > 4s for 5m. Paging oncall @here
Alice: ack, I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now.
Ben: I see it — p95 ~900ms but p99 jumps to 5.8s. Looks concentrated on model-group: llama-2-13b-q4 and streaming-enabled routes.
Carla: eyeballing logs — a bunch of mixed-seqlen streaming requests with long tails showing many small sequences queued with a few very long sequences (>>1024). Might be padding amplification.
Dave: can you paste the prometheus query?
Carla: sure. query i ran: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_seconds_bucket{path="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))`
Carla: and filtering by `handler=\"continuous-batcher\"` shows the spike.
Emily: also seeing `batch_queue_length` climb and `streaming_stall_rate` increasing — streaming workers starved waiting for preempted long KV cache loads.
Alice: first mitigation idea: temporarily lower `max_batch_size` for continuous-batcher in us-west-2 to reduce amplification and force quicker flushes. fallback route to dedicated-stream workers for long seqs.
Ben: +1. We can also enable sequence-length binning (strict binning) for cont-batch to prevent huge variance in batch composition. However config change risky during live incident.
Dave: what about a quick config flip — `continuous-batcher.max_batch_size: 64 -> 32` and `contbatch.strict_seqlen_bins: true`? that'll reduce packing efficiency but should cut tail.
Alice: ok i'm going to push a scoped runtime override to us-west-2 only. doing now.
Ops-Bot: deploy-bot started deploy 398deploy-ctb-quickfix by Alice — rolling to us-west-2 nodes.
Ben: while that rolls, can we isolate streaming paths? add an SLO-based routing rule: if request.streaming == true and seq_len > 1024 then route to `streaming-priority` worker pool.
Carla: adding a temporary routing rule now — pushed to the control plane. should be active in ~30s.
Dave: logs show a drop in large batches being formed. p99 down to ~2.1s within 90s of deploy.
Emily: monitoring `kv-cache-hit` and `kv-evict-rate` — eviction spiked earlier; after routing change eviction pressure reduced. good sign.
Alice: can we identify customers hit? query: `topk(10, sum(rate(requests_total{region="us-west-2",handler="continuous-batcher"}[15m])) by (customer_id))`
Ben: found 3 high-volume tenants: CustA (priority), CustB (dev), CustC (internal). CustA has ~30% of cont-batch traffic in the window.
Carla: reached out to CustA via acct slack — they're seeing some degraded latency but no errors. recommended throttling heavy long-seq jobs.
Emily: alerting rule suppression? we should suppress noisy p95 alerts while working mitigation to avoid alarm fatigue.
Alice: going to mute the p99 page for cont-batch for 30m and keep pager for SLO breach on `customer-impact=true`.
Ops-Bot: alert-suppression applied (timeout 30m) by Alice.
Ben: next steps: 1) Keep routing rule for long seqs for 2h 2) keep max_batch_size lowered for 1h 3) run an async job to recompute seqlen bins using 24h traffic 4) schedule postmortem if recurrence.
Dave: noted. I'll start the seqlen histogram job: `python tools/compute_bins.py --region us-west-2 --past 24h --out /tmp/seqlen_bins.json`. will share results in 30m.
Carla: quick root-cause note: mixed-seqlen packing + streaming requests that pin KV cache + insufficient preemption for long sequences -> batch starvation and amplification at tail.
Emily: customer impact: transient latency spike, no 5xx, a few degraded SLAs for p99 on heavy-tail tenants. Ops contacted CustA and gave workaround.
Alice: handing off now to Ben for post-incident follow-up. I’ll be offline for the next 45m. summary in one line: lowered cont-batch max_batch_size, enabled strict seqlen binning, routed long streaming to priority pool; p99 reduced from ~5.8s to ~1.9-2.3s.
Ben: taking handoff. I’ll monitor for 2h and follow up with config rollback plan after bins recompute. Opening a short incident notice for customers.
Ops-Bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-3961234567 by Ben.
Dave: pushing compute job results to #eng-ml when ready. tagging Emily for customer comms draft.
Emily: will draft a quick customer-facing status and post to support queue: notes about mitigation and recommended request sizing guidance.
Alice: thanks team. adding action items to follow-up: action: full postmortem in 48h, action: adjust default routing to detect hetero seqlen in cont-batch, action: automate preemptive shedding for KV-heavy sequences.
Ben: copying the short mitigation timeline here: 
```
00:00 Ops-Bot page -> p99>4.5s
00:02 Alice ack, initial triage
00:05 Routing rule for seq_len>1024 -> streaming-priority pushed
00:07 Alice runtime override max_batch_size 64->32 rolled us-west-2
00:09 p99 dropped to ~2.1s
00:12 suppression of noisy p99 alerts for 30m
00:30 follow-ups: bin recompute job started
```
Ben: if anything regresses, re-page @here. closing this thread for the live mitigation handoff. Follow-up updates go into INC-2026-3961234567. :thumbsup:
